name: DeepSeek-Reasonix
tagline: DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for your terminal, engineered around prefix-cache stability
description: DeepSeek-Reasonix is a terminal-based AI coding agent built natively for DeepSeek models. It is engineered around prefix-cache stability: the idea that keeping the prompt prefix stable lets the DeepSeek backend reuse cached reasoning, which both cuts cost and latency and keeps long-lived sessions fast. The agent ships as a Go binary with a TUI, supports tool use and terminal workflows, and is designed to be left running rather than restarted per task.
highlights: DeepSeek-native agent with prompt-cache-aware session design
Engineered for long-running use: leave it running instead of restarting per task
Go binary with a full TUI and tool-use support
33k+ stars and an active 2k+ fork community
Terminal-first experience for coding agent workflows
curatorNote: Most coding agents are model-agnostic glue; Reasonix is deliberately DeepSeek-native, and the prefix-cache-stability design is a genuinely different engineering philosophy — cheaper, faster, and built for sessions that outlive a single task.
